known_residue.small_launcher: pale one pixel rim: the renderer's blended edge pixels are inside the mask
known_residue.hangar: validation sprites: the two grey end wall stubs are in, a 1 px light line along the arch is only partly in; helsinki: arch band and stubs are in. The ground seen through the door is left out on purpose
known_residue.medium_plane: the olive left wing tip comes from reflecting the GrabCut mask about the fuselage axis; at 40 degrees off-nadir the plane is not exactly mirror symmetric, so the tip outline is approximate (about 1 px)
known_residue.tank: barrels of f129, f195 and f206 come from the black-hat line pass and are 1 px wide with a 1 px bridge to the turret
